description: Sen. Kristen Thompson, R-Edmond, announced that the Oklahoma Water Resources Board approved a $2 million Progressing Rural Economic Prosperity (PREP) grant to support the Piedmont Municipal Authority’s water system upgrades. The grant, combined with an $809,080 OWRB Financial Assistance Program loan, will fund a $2.81 million project to design and construct approximately 9,200 feet of new 16-inch waterline and related infrastructure. “Reliable water is […]
title: Senator Thompson secures $2M PREP grant for Piedmont - Kristen for Oklahoma
